items.title: Gene Bertoncini interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2001
items.q: The transcript contains no interaction or narrative between Gene Bertoncini and Monk; the name 'Monk' appears only in the interviewer's address to the interviewee.

ctx.x: Monk, it’s a pleasure to be here with you.
I think you’re going to have a good year, and I hope some of those things come true for you. It’s a beautiful piece and I’m sure the rest of the CD holds up to it also.
